name: zvid_image_set_format_code
description: zVid_Image::SetFormatCode stores the supplied format byte in zVidImagePartial::formatFlagsPacked and returns zero.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVid_Image helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ec60 validates a direct formatFlagsPacked byte store and zero return.
The native zVid image helper smoke verifies the stored format code before alpha and size helpers update the same image.
